$comment: The build's budgets (scripts/budgets.ts says what each number weighs and counts): bytes gzipped at level 9, files in dist/, and requests before a page's first paint. The app file's budget is Paul's 700 KB (2026-10-12, the app in one file measured at 669 KB); the rest are the sizes of 2026-10-12 plus about 5%. Files: 111 measured (112 in a build given the site's address, which writes sitemap.xml), where the design's list comes to 84 (82 by its items: eleven pages, the app file, the stylesheet, eleven templates files, twenty languages, the worker, the API, sixteen faces, eleven cards, the manifest and six icons, robots.txt, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, version.json). The other 29 were in dist/ before and are served still: the embed page and network.html; the API's second file, api/parts-<hash>.js; the fonts' licence (fonts/LICENSE.txt, which the OFL asks to travel with the faces); the site's own card, og.png; eleven examples/<app>.json and eleven llms/<app>.txt for agents, and .well-known/llms.txt; tinyoffice.js and its types, tinyoffice.d.ts, for a page that writes links; _headers, which the edge reads and never serves. The request budget is the page, the app file, the stylesheet and the two Latin faces: five, as the design says; the theme script, which sets light or dark before the first paint, is in the page (index.html), its hash in the policy (Paul, 2026-10-12: "Inline the script."). The fonts' line is the type of 2026-10-12 plus about 5%, raised by the bytes of Plex Sans Hebrew's two faces (33,260 and 35,152) when Hebrew and Yiddish came. npm run build fails when anything is over; the budget is a tripwire against growth nobody meant, not a ceiling on clarity: growth that buys simplicity is raised here, in a commit of its own whose message says why. 2026-10-15: the Trip Planner's map became MapLibre on OpenFreeMap (issue #4; Paul: "hot-load it for that path"): two files more, the map's chunk and its worker, fetched with the first map and never by a page; and the stylesheet's line rose from 30,400 to 35,000 for MapLibre's rules (3,858 bytes gzipped), one stylesheet still. The API's second file was raised from 272,000 to 309,000 when the strings moved to Fluent (Paul, 2026-10-15: "Use Fluent"): English, once the keys themselves and in no file of its own, is now en.ftl's messages under their ids, with @fluent/bundle to read them, 261,208 bytes then 294,076, and about 5% above that. 2026-10-17: the Board, an eleventh app, came back as a view of a table (Atlas's pipeline is a Tiny Little Office view over records): its templates file (1,156 bytes, budgeted 1,214), its stylesheet (the stylesheet 35,099 to 35,504 bytes, its line raised from 35,500 to 36,000) and four files more (its templates file, its share card, examples/board.json and llms/board.txt: 114 to 118, the line from 115 to 122); the app file grew 8.5 KB, within its line.
